text: Reformulate the task if you cannot solve it. For example, instead of “How can I earn more money?” find the answer to the question: “How can I create more value for others?”. Instead of “How can I get rid of fear?”—“What could I do if I were not afraid?”. Often a change of perspective completely changes the landscape and opens up non-obvious solutions. The more radical the change of point of view, the more effective this method is. Experiment. Inverted asanas are a “magical” way to develop the ability to completely invert your point of view.
